title: Commuting square for restriction units under an embedding and change of universe
statement: Let $X,Z$ be topological spaces in universe $u$, let $i:Z\to X$ be a continuous embedding (injective with the topology on $Z$ induced from $X$), let $Y$ be a topological space in universe $u+1$, and let $e:Y\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ be a homeomorphism. Put $D=e^{-1}(\operatorname{range}(i))$ with its subspace topology and let $j:D\hookrightarrow Y$ be the inclusion. For every sheaf $G$ of $\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$ on $X$, there exist a sheaf $F$ of $\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$ on $Y$ and bijections $a:\Gamma(X,G)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(Y,F)$ and $b:\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}G)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(D,j^{-1}F)$ such that $b\circ r_i=r_j\circ a$. Here $r_i,r_j$ are the inverse-image adjunction units evaluated at the top open and inverse image is left Kan extension followed by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. No compactness, spectrality, closedness or connectedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09ZG, closed-image and universe-transport step of lem-weil-pbc-zariski-closed-immersion-connected-restriction; the unit comparison is Mathlib Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app

proof.text: Precompose the sheaf with the opposite functor of the open-set order isomorphism induced by e. Open covers, matching families and unique gluings correspond, giving a sheaf F and the equivalence a on global sections.

An embedding identifies Z homeomorphically with its range. Restrict e to the inverse image D of this range and combine the two homeomorphisms. The induced equivalences of sheaf categories identify the pushforward functors.

Transport the inverse-image adjunction along these equivalences and compare left adjoints of the identified pushforward functor. The unique comparison isomorphism preserves the units. Evaluation at the top open gives the equivalence b and the equation of the commuting square.

theorem closed_embedding_restriction_transport_square
    {X Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : Topology.IsEmbedding i)
    (Y : TopCat.{u + 1}) (e : Y ≃ₜ X) :
    letI : ∀ P : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1),
        (Opens.map i).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension P :=
      fun P U ↦ @Types.hasColimit.{u, u + 1, u}
        (CostructuredArrow.{u, u, u, u} (Opens.map i).op U)
        inferInstance (small_succ.{u} _) (CostructuredArrow.proj _ U ⋙ P)
    let A := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
      (Opens.map i) (Type (u + 1))
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
    let D : Set Y := e ⁻¹' Set.range i
    let j : TopCat.of D ⟶ Y := TopCat.ofHom ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
    let B := Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Type (u + 1)) j
    ∀ G : X.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)),
      ∃ (F : Y.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)))
        (a : G.1.obj (op ⊤) ≃ F.1.obj (op ⊤))
        (b : ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Opens.map i)
          (Type (u + 1)) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)).obj G).1.obj (op ((Opens.map i).obj ⊤)) ≃
          ((Sheaf.pullback (Type (u + 1)) j).obj F).1.obj (op ((Opens.map j).obj ⊤))),
        ∀ s, b ((A.unit.app G).hom.app (op ⊤) s) =
          (B.unit.app F).hom.app (op ⊤) (a s)
